capabilities: Analyze distance areas of the link and tag graph
Suggest tags from note content and existing tags
Associate local external files with notes through metadata notes, thumbnails, and Bases
Inspect areas in interactive partial graphs and color the standard graph
Detect and clean up orphaned metadata notes, thumbnails, and Bases
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a backup, sync, or file-keeping tool; its core job is analyzing graph structure built from links and tags.
extras: Desktop-only (tested on Windows, macOS/Linux compatibility unverified); community directory approval pending so manual installation is required; UI is bilingual English/Japanese with some Japanese remnants; no telemetry; warns that metadata notes store absolute local paths which can reveal usernames when sharing a vault.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows raw connections but does not analyze cluster structure, classify areas, or suggest tags, and linking files outside the vault is unsupported.
summary: Graph analysis plugin that computes link-and-tag distance areas, suggests tags, and associates local external files with notes via metadata notes and Bases.
